description: This file implements a socket adaptor class for Unix domain sockets, managing socket creation, connection, data transfer, and listening operations. It handles both server and client functionalities, including connection management, threading, and callback registration.

classes.name: socket_adaptor
classes.description: A class providing Unix domain socket server and client functionalities, including connection management, data transfer, and event handling through callbacks.

methods.name: connect_socket
methods.description: Connects to a Unix domain socket at the specified path.

methods.name: write_data
methods.description: Writes data into the socket; handles partial writes and socket closure.

methods.name: fetch_data
methods.description: Reads data from the socket into internal buffer.

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Provides the fetched data to external caller in vector or buffer.

methods.name: start_listening
methods.description: Starts listening on the specified socket path for incoming connections, spawning a worker thread.

methods.name: stop_listening
methods.description: Stops listening, closes sockets, and cleans up resources.

methods.name: worker_thread
methods.description: Thread function for monitoring multiple socket events and control signals.

methods.name: process_control_message
methods.description: Handles control messages such as shutdown or callback registration.
